name: Prisma
description_en:
Prisma now presents a TypeScript application platform spanning Prisma ORM, managed Prisma Postgres and Prisma Compute hosting. These are distinct components: the ORM data layer is not the hosted database, and using Postgres does not require adopting every Prisma service.

The current documentation makes version selection unusually important. ORM 8 is a release candidate with a TypeScript contract workflow; ORM 7 remains a separate supported route. This profile examines a proposed app’s schema lifecycle, database recovery, preview isolation and operating bill. No dependency, database, account or deployment was created.
description_zh:
Prisma 当前介绍覆盖 Prisma ORM、托管 Prisma Postgres 及 Prisma Compute 主机的 TypeScript 应用平台。三者是不同组件：ORM 数据层不等于托管数据库，使用 Postgres 也不要求采用全部 Prisma 服务。

当前文档尤其需要明确版本：ORM 8 是采用 TypeScript contract 流程的候选发布版，ORM 7 则保留独立支持路径。本文评估拟建应用的 schema 生命周期、数据库恢复、预览隔离及运行费用；本次未创建依赖、数据库、账户或部署。

sections.title_en: Choose the ORM generation before following examples
sections.title_zh: 先选 ORM 代际，再采用示例
sections.en: ORM 8 replaces the familiar schema/client workflow with contract.prisma, emitted artifacts and a generated db import. Its documented engine coverage is PostgreSQL, early-access MongoDB and experimental SQLite; other listed engines point to ORM 7. Pin a deliberate version and follow that generation’s guide rather than combining commands from old tutorials with the new default. An RC label is not production compatibility evidence.
sections.zh: ORM 8 用 contract.prisma、生成产物及 db 导入替代熟悉的 schema／client 流程。文档列出 PostgreSQL、抢先体验 MongoDB 及实验性 SQLite，其他所列引擎指向 ORM 7。应明确固定版本并跟随对应指南，避免混用旧教程命令与新默认版。候选发布标签不证明生产兼容性。

sections.title_en: A migration plan does not execute itself
sections.title_zh: 迁移计划不会自行执行
sections.en: The new migration workflow separates editing/emitting a contract, planning changes, reviewing the result and applying it. A plan alone does not change the database. Execution uses generated operations, so edits to migration source must be recompiled. The first plan without a prior reference assumes an empty starting point; an existing database needs the documented baseline procedure. Review the actual SQL and target before any production application.
sections.zh: 新迁移流程分开编辑／生成 contract、规划、审查及应用变更，只有计划不会改变数据库。执行使用生成的操作，因此迁移源码修改后需重新编译。没有先前引用的首个计划假定起点为空，已有数据库需按文档建立基线。生产应用前应检查实际 SQL 和目标。

sections.title_en: A temporary database needs an ownership decision
sections.title_zh: 临时数据库需要明确归属
sections.en: Prisma Postgres accepts ordinary PostgreSQL clients as well as Prisma-oriented access. The create-db flow returns a connection string and claim link; an unclaimed temporary database is deleted after 24 hours. Treat that as an evaluation resource, not durable application storage. Select the intended pooled or direct endpoint and protect credentials; a successful local query does not establish backup coverage or production ownership.
sections.zh: Prisma Postgres 接受常规 PostgreSQL 客户端及 Prisma 访问方式。create-db 流程返回连接串和认领链接，未认领临时数据库在 24 小时后删除。应将其作为评估资源，而非持久应用存储；需选择合适池化／直接端点并保护凭据。本地查询成功不证明备份覆盖或生产归属。

sections.title_en: Snapshot recovery has a data-loss window
sections.title_zh: 快照恢复存在数据丢失窗口
sections.en: Paid plans document daily snapshots on days with database activity, retained for seven or thirty days depending on tier. Changes after the latest snapshot may be lost. Point-in-time recovery is described as future functionality. Manual pg_dump uses the direct connection and compatible PostgreSQL tools. Select a recovery objective and inspect a separate restore before depending on snapshots; no backup or restore was run here.
sections.zh: 付费方案记载在有数据库活动的日期生成每日快照，按层级保留七天或三十天；最后快照之后的变更可能丢失。时间点恢复仍列为未来能力。手动 pg_dump 使用直接连接和兼容 PostgreSQL 工具。依赖快照前应明确恢复目标并在独立环境检查恢复，本次未执行备份或恢复。

sections.title_en: A preview branch is not automatic data isolation
sections.title_zh: 预览分支不自动隔离数据
sections.en: Compute groups services and versions under projects and branches. Preview-scoped variables must point DATABASE_URL at non-production data when isolation is required. The limitations page explicitly excludes automatic production data cloning and automatic production migrations on deploy. A branch name alone is insufficient: inspect resolved configuration, schema compatibility and the actual target database before a preview accepts writes.
sections.zh: Compute 在项目／分支下管理服务及版本。需要隔离时，预览作用域变量必须将 DATABASE_URL 指向非生产数据。限制页明确不自动克隆生产数据，也不在部署时自动执行生产迁移。仅有分支名不足，应在预览接受写入前核对配置、schema 兼容性及真实数据库目标。

sections.title_en: Promotion and rollback affect application artifacts
sections.title_zh: 提升及回退作用于应用产物
sections.en: The deployment guide says promoting a preview rebuilds with production variables, while rollback reuses an existing build. Version logs and build output help distinguish runtime and build failures. This is not a documented database undo operation: coordinate schema compatibility with the selected application version. Changing a stored environment value also requires a new deploy to affect a version. No build, promotion or rollback was tested.
sections.zh: 部署指南称预览提升会用生产变量重新构建，回退则复用已有构建。版本日志和构建输出有助区分运行与构建失败。这不是文档中的数据库撤销操作，应协调所选应用版本与 schema 兼容性。已保存环境变量变更也需新部署才能影响版本。本次未测试构建、提升或回退。

sections.title_en: HTTP hosting has concrete runtime limits
sections.title_zh: HTTP 主机有明确运行限制
sections.en: Compute currently has no WebSocket servers, persistent filesystem or multi-region service deployment. A request must begin responding within sixty seconds; streaming has a different first-byte boundary. Keep-awake primitives do not guarantee continuity through restarts. A Composer scheduler service or external scheduler is distinct from a built-in platform cron. Confirm the real workload fits these constraints before treating a coming-soon homepage item as available.
sections.zh: Compute 当前不支持 WebSocket 服务、持久文件系统或多区域服务部署。请求需在六十秒内开始响应，流式响应适用首字节边界。保持唤醒工具不保证重启期间连续运行。Composer 调度服务或外部调度器也不同于平台内置 cron。应核对实际负载，不能把首页即将推出项目当成可用功能。

sections.title_en: Database and application hosting use different meters
sections.title_zh: 数据库与应用主机采用不同计量
sections.en: The displayed Free plan includes 200,000 database operations and 2 GB storage; paid entry starts at $10 per month. The FAQ counts one database action as one operation even for a complex join. Compute instead meters requests, provisioned memory, active CPU and outbound traffic. Database transfer inclusion does not remove Compute bandwidth charges. Paid overage and spend-limit settings need an account-specific review; checkout currency, taxes and actual invoicing were not verified.
sections.zh: 显示的 Free 包含二十万数据库操作及 2 GB 存储，付费入门为每月 $10。FAQ 将一次数据库动作计为一次操作，即使查询含复杂连接。Compute 则按请求、预置内存、活跃 CPU 及出站流量计量。数据库传输包含在内不代表 Compute 带宽免费。付费超额及消费上限需按账户核对，本次未核结账币种、税及实际账单。
